### Change
The high-severity alert was `os.chmod(path, PUBLIC_FILE_MODE)` with `PUBLIC_FILE_MODE = 0o644` in `_write_public_receipt` — world-readable on disk.

- Removed `PUBLIC_FILE_MODE` (`0o644`).
- Renamed helpers: `_regular_public` → `_regular_text_free_receipt`, `_read_public_json` → `_read_text_free_receipt_json`, `_write_public_receipt` → `_write_text_free_receipt`.
- Text-free receipts now use `PRIVATE_FILE_MODE` (`0o600`) with temp-file chmod before `os.replace`, matching `_atomic_write` / `phase3_rule_author_runner`.
- `_regular_text_free_receipt` asserts mode `0600` and `mode & 0o077 == 0`.
- Private output paths still require `0700` directories and `0600` files (unchanged).

| Artifact | Mode |
|----------|------|
| Inventory receipt on disk | `0o600` (no group/other bits) |
| Private manifest parent | `0o700` (existing gate) |
| Private manifest file | `0o600` (existing gate) |
